methods.notes: A PROFILE, not a single value: 3-4 RPMs at 25C => a thixotropy curve. Each (spindle,rpm) is its own observation; aggregating across RPM is invalid (different shear).
Unit may be micron OR mm — must be carried per observation (commensurability).

PROJECT PROTOCOL: time in minutes from start until back-face/sample reaches 500C. Distinct from EN 13381-8; method string must say so or values are not commensurable.

structural_findings: Universal QC core: every coating project measures ph + specific_gravity + viscosity_profile first; this is the shared baseline before project-specific axes.
Viscosity is a PROFILE (spindle 1-4 x RPM 6/12/30/60 @ 25C), not a scalar — each (spindle,rpm) is a distinct observation; never aggregate across shear rates.
expansion_factor is a COMPOSITE (foam_height / initial_thickness) — confirms the composite-axis trap; capture the two primary components, derive the ratio.
INT-TFX fire time is a PROJECT protocol (heat to 500C, count minutes), NOT EN 13381-8 — the method string must distinguish them or the values are not commensurable.
